title: Why was my Everyone Pay transaction declined?
summary: Explains why an Everyone Pay transaction was declined due to limit thresholds ($1,500 daily / $12,500 monthly per individual), insufficient available balance, invalid/unverified recipient details, a temporary security review for unusual activity, or network/system interruptions. Provides resolution steps (adjust amount, verify recipient, change funding account, wait and retry, contact support).
faqs: Was my Everyone Pay transaction declined because I hit the daily or monthly limit?
